title: Reference solution: Process data larger than available RAM
answer:
import os, tempfile
import numpy as np

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    path = os.path.join(folder, 'large.dat')
    arr = np.memmap(path, dtype='float32', mode='w+', shape=(4,))
    arr[:] = [1, 2, 3, 4]
    arr.flush()
    del arr
    read_only = np.memmap(path, dtype='float32', mode='r', shape=(4,))
    print(read_only.tolist())
    del read_only
